description:
Test build, not a release. For stable builds use main/bundles/stable.json.

- Inline images, Inline videos and Inline tables now switch on and off independently.
- "Long press media to select comment" works on images, videos and tables, and is available while any of them is on.
- Size settings (Scale to fit, Limit width/height) apply to images and videos and now sit below the video settings.
